## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Failure-report selection should match the same path spellings as explicit selection so requested failures are included in reruns.

## Changes

The pull request adds a failure-report selector that preserves the spelling of selected paths. It also refactors cached selection and adds tests for all three selectors.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Match `./` paths in failure reports — A report listing `./tests/test_x.py` returns an empty selection when `tests/test_x.py` is requested. The selector compares raw paths, while `select_explicit` normalizes paths for matching. — A rerun can omit a requested test that failed in the previous run. — Fix: Reuse `select_explicit` for the report’s failed paths to preserve their original spelling in the result.
